content_sections.heading: SHS Mumbai Content Researcher Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for SHS Mumbai Content Researcher Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for the Content Researcher position?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Content Researcher position at State Health Society Mumbai is scheduled for 01 September 2026. Candidates should ensure they report to the venue on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Content Researcher role?
faq.answer: A Bachelor's Degree in Public Administration, Public Policy, Political Science, Governance, Social Sciences, or a related field is required. A Master's degree in a similar discipline is desirable.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Content Researcher position is 55 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Content Researcher post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Content Researcher position will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 74,323 per month.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Content Researcher post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Content Researcher position at the State Health Society Mumbai.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: This recruitment is being conducted through a Walk-in Interview. Candidates do not need to apply online beforehand.

faq.question: Q7. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, including ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if any), and category certificates, along with one set of self-attested photocopies.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Yes, there is an application fee. General/OBC candidates need to pay Rs. 750, and Reserved Category candidates need to pay Rs. 500.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The Content Researcher position is a contractual role.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the Important Links section of this article. It contains all the detailed information regarding the recruitment.
